parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: This is a wheel of the cart made of rubber, cylindrical in shape and attached to the base body for rolling movement.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the cart’s movement by rolling on the ground, providing traction and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its central axis to enable forward and backward motion of the cart.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: This is another wheel of the cart, identical to the first one, made of rubber and attached to the opposite side of the base body.
parts.Functional_description: It works in conjunction with the other wheel to balance and move the cart smoothly.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis, synchronized with the other wheel for stable motion.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the cart made of steel, rectangular in shape with structural support for carrying loads.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the primary structure that holds the load and connects all other parts, including the wheels and handles.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary relative to the wheels, providing a stable platform for the cart’s operation.
